remaining_risks: body-parser@2.3.0 remains in lock; re-enabling inflate or adding a default parser reopens the affected path.
Undocumented external clients sending compressed JSON will receive 415.
Other Goal 18 findings/advisories, general resource-exhaustion protection, remote CI and deployed image were not revalidated.
